Subject: Post-demo follow-up: SOC 2 access + next steps for Alpenglow

Hi Sara —

Thanks again for taking the demo today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

1) Scope/need: Alpenglow is evaluating Redwood for patient-facing summarization workflows (PHI in scope). You flagged SOC 2 Type II + HIPAA alignment as gating items.

2) Immediate asks from your team: SOC 2 Type II report or interim attestation, a short bridge letter for the current period, and access to a trust/evidence portal where you can pull artifacts. Also mentioned was a brief vendor security questionnaire (DSQ).

3) Our proposed timeline:
   - We can provide a temporary bridge letter + SOC 2 summary within 24–48 hours once we confirm contact for portal provisioning.
   - Full Type II report delivery depends on our next release window (we can share the report or a redacted version under an NDA).

4) Next steps that would unblock us:
   - Please confirm the person on your side who will need portal access (name + work email + any IP allowlist requirements).
   - If you prefer we fill a DSQ, please send the vendor questionnaire link (or let us know if you want us to complete your DocuSign/Qualify forms).

I'm attaching a short security one-pager. I'm looping Ben (account lead) to coordinate commercial/DocuSign items and Rishi (security) for the bridge letter and portal access.

Thanks — looking forward to lining up the items so your security team can begin reviewing.

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

Thanks for the clear recap. I'm the security lead at Alpenglow and will be the portal contact. A few clarifying notes:

- Because PHI is in scope, we also require a signed BAA (we can start an internal procurement ticket once we have your standard BAA).
- We'd like Redwood to complete our vendor security questionnaire (we use a short DSQ form; I'll attach it). If you prefer, I can send a DocuSign link.
- Portal access: please invite security@alpenglow.health and sara.nguyen@alpenglow.health. We have IP allowlisting for external portals — IPs are 34.210.12.5 and 34.210.12.6.

Timeline: we'd aim to complete intake and initial review by next Friday (05 May) if we can get the bridge letter and DSQ answers this week.

Attaching the DSQ now.
